content.short: Foundry Template provides a Foundry-stack template with testing tools for Solidity smart contracts.
content.description: Foundry Template is a Foundry-based smart contract template that bundles tools for fuzzing, debugging, and deploying to a chain. It provides building blocks and extensions to help developers create Solidity contracts more efficiently. A concise cheat sheet guides safe and fast development, while reusable patterns and templates accelerate coding. The template also includes Solhint and Prettier Solidity plugins for VS Code. It supports Ethereum and other networks, including Multichain, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum, and BNB Chain.
content.meta: Foundry Template is a Foundry-stack template with Solidity testing tools. Discover Foundry Template and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
